lead.headline: The Bass claim cost you your defence — add Washington today
lead.deck: 2-5. A free-agent D/ST for Fairbairn now, then Coker for Diggs before Thursday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Last night's Tyler Bass claim went through at 01:33, but the player it dropped was the Broncos D/ST, not Ka'imi Fairbairn. AVIATO now carry two kickers, one of them on a Houston bye, and nothing in the D/ST slot. The fix costs nothing: the Commanders D/ST is a free agent, projects 7.9, and faces a Philadelphia offence led by rookie Tanner McKee with Jalen Hurts on IR. Drop Fairbairn. The rest of last night's plan landed — Hockenson claimed, Allen back at quarterback, Tuten in. One change remains: Jalen Coker (14.6), who practised fully on Tuesday, over Stefon Diggs (12.6) before Carolina kick off Thursday. Guillo-tinas project 88.9 only because Kittle is on bye and Nacua and Lamar Jackson sit; expect them near 120.

doFirst.headline: One free add today, one swap before Thursday
doFirst.deck: Commanders D/ST for Fairbairn; Coker over Diggs by 18:15 Thursday.
doFirst.note: The defence is a free agent — no waiver, no priority. Do it before anyone else streams Washington.
doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide before Thursday.
